applies: Adds a NotificationService class that validates a ticket, writes it to the database, formats the email and sends it
Introduces a RepositoryFactory and a Repository interface although only one repository class exists
Adds a retry wrapper around the billing client that returns a default invoice when all attempts fail
Adds a base Handler class with three subclasses, one of which overrides a method to raise NotImplementedError
Adds a function with a mode flag that switches between exporting CSV and exporting JSON, and a new dependency to parse dates
Rewrites the document ingestion module into new classes and helper functions
does_not_apply: Fixes a typo in the README
Renames a CSS class in a button component
Adds a unit test for a date-formatting helper
Changes a timeout value in a configuration file from 5 to 10 seconds
Reorders the columns of a report table in the UI
Reformats a file with the project's formatter and sorts its imports
Adds a deploy job to the GitHub Actions workflow and a Terraform module for the queue it deploys to
